description.en: Animated UI primitives and motion widgets designed for modern Tailwind CSS.
description.zh: 专为现代 Tailwind CSS 深度调校的高性能动效原语与交互式小部件。

content.en: Skiper UI is an animated component library created to supercharge Tailwind CSS landing pages. It provides smooth carousels, dynamic headers, kinetic text banners, and interactive cards that slot seamlessly into existing Tailwind configurations.
content.zh: Skiper UI 是一套为现代 Tailwind CSS 落地页深度定制的动效增强组件库。涵盖了流畅轮播卡片、动态呼吸导航栏、动力学滚动文字横幅与视差悬浮网格，能够毫无缝隙地嵌入到现有的 Tailwind 配置体系中，实现快速视觉升级。
